# Long-Term Leave Information (2 Years)

Based on the supplied evidence, there are **two main types of leave** that can be granted for approximately 2 years:

## 1. Study Leave [C1]

| Feature | Details |
|---------|---------|
| **Maximum Duration** | Up to five (05) years throughout entire service [C1] |
| **Term Structure** | First term followed by another term after two (02) years of compulsory service [C1] |
| **Minimum Service Required** | At least two (02) years of service in NUST; waiver will not be given [C1] |
| **Payment Terms** | With pay as per balance/authorized EL and the rest without pay (EOL) [C1] |
| **Probation Status** | Not explicitly addressed for Study Leave specifically, but EOL requires removal from probation [C4] |

## 2. Extraordinary Leave (EOL) [C4]

| Feature | Details |
|---------|---------|
| **Maximum Duration** | Four (04) years throughout entire service; two (02) years at a stretch without extension [C4] |
| **Probation Requirement** | Employee must have been removed from probation to avail EOL [C4] |
| **Payment Terms** | Without pay for deputation/attachment to higher administrative position [C4] |
| **Increments** | No increments admissible during EOL [C4] |

## 3. Ex-Pakistan Leave (EPL) [C1, C2]

| Feature | Details |
|---------|---------|
| **Maximum Duration** | Maximum of thirty (30) days at a time or part thereof [C1] |
| **Note** | This is NOT a 2-year leave; maximum per instance is 30 days [C1] |

## Key Constraints for Associate Professor

- **Probation**: EOL requires removal from probation [C4]; Study Leave does not explicitly address probation status but has minimum 2 years service requirement [C1]
- **Service Requirement**: Minimum two (02) years of service in NUST is mandatory and waiver will not be given for Study Leave [C1]
- **Contract/Retirement**: Leave cannot be granted beyond end of contract date or retirement date [C1, C4]

## Summary

| Leave Type | Max Duration | Probation Impact | Payment |
|------------|-------------|------------------|---------|
| Study Leave | Up to 5 years (2-year terms) | Not explicitly stated | With/Without pay per authorization [C1] |
| EOL | 4 years total, 2 years max at stretch | Must be removed from probation [C4] | Without pay for deputation [C4] |
| EPL | Maximum 30 days (NOT 2 years) | Not applicable | As per authorization [C1] |

**Note**: If you are currently on probation, you may not be eligible for EOL as it requires removal from probation [C4]. For Study Leave, the evidence does not explicitly address probation status but requires minimum 2 years of service first [C1].

Based on the supplied evidence, you cannot take Extraordinary Leave (EOL) while currently on probation. The policy explicitly states that to avail EOL, the employee must have been removed from probation [C2]. Consequently, your eligibility for this leave is contingent upon completing your probation period first.

Regarding the specific timing of your joining date (9th Feb 2026), the provided evidence does not contain personal records or specific dates regarding your employment start date; it only outlines general policy rules [C2]. The Leave Policy document was last updated on 06/07/2022 [C1], so these rules apply to that version of the policy.

Regarding the duration you inquired about (2 years), the evidence specifies the following limits for EOL:
*   **Maximum Duration:** EOL shall not exceed four (04) years throughout the entire service of an employee and two (02) years at a stretch without any provision for extension [C2].
*   **Gap Requirement:** There will be a minimum gap of 3 years between EOL for research/ postdoc [C2].
*   **Service Requirement:** While specific study leave requires two (02) years of service, the evidence does not explicitly state a minimum service requirement for EOL other than the probation removal condition [C2].

The policy also notes that EOL will be governed by the Competent Authority's satisfaction that such leave is in the larger interest of the University [C2], and it cannot be granted beyond the end of contract date or date of retirement [C2].

# Faculty Load Information for Associate Professors

Based on the supplied evidence, **there is no specific load value explicitly stated for Associate Professors**. The policy documents provide general categories that may or may not apply to Associate Professors depending on their status and circumstances.

## Minimum Teaching Load (All Faculty)
- **3 CH per semester** is the minimum mandatory teaching load for all faculty members [C1]

## Overall Faculty Load Structure (per semester)
The overall load includes: Teaching + Research + Institutional Services = ~12 CH minimum for regular faculty [C8]

| Component | Range/Value | Citation |
|-----------|-------------|----------|
| **Teaching Load** | Minimum 3 CH per semester | [C1] |
| **Research Load** | 0 to 6 CH equivalent load | [C11] |
| **Institutional Services** | Maximum 3 CH (varies by role) | [C9] |

## Faculty-Specific Loads (May Apply to Associate Professors)

| Category | Load | Citation |
|----------|------|----------|
| Newly joined PhD faculty (first year) | 8 CH per semester | [C8] |
| Lecturers / Lab Engrs (post-PhD return) | 8 CH load | [C1] |
| Newly joined MS qualified faculty | 12 CH load | [C1] |
| Regular faculty members | ~12 CH minimum | [C8] |

## Research Load Details for Associate Professors
Research load varies based on activities:

| Activity | Load | Citation |
|----------|------|----------|
| PhD supervision (supervisor) | 1 CH per student per semester | [C11] |
| PhD supervision (co-supervisor) | 0.5 CH per student per semester | [C11] |
| MS/MBA/equivalent supervision | 0.75 CH per student per semester | [C11] |
| Funding (Principal Investigator, up to 1M/semester) | 1 CH | [C11] |
| Funding (Co-PI, up to 1M/semester) | 0.5 CH | [C11] |

## Policy Applicability
- The Faculty Load Policy is applicable w.e.f **Fall 2023** [C12]
- Overall evaluation of faculty load is done on a **yearly basis** by Acad Dte [C1]
